caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil sketch on an off-white or beige background. It features a round, shallow dish or plate with a slightly raised circular center, displayed in a direct top-down view. At the top of the dish, there is an ornate handle or decorative element, which appears to be symmetrical and contains circular and spade-shaped cutout patterns, as well as the letters "G N E" arranged vertically within the handle. A thin rectangular border frames the main drawing. In the lower right corner, there is a small inset diagram showing a side profile of the dish, which reveals its shallow depth and gently curved sides. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten signature and date that reads "17th June" and a name that appears to be "Strane" or similar. The composition is precise and rendered entirely in shades of gray pencil, with subtle shading providing a sense of depth and curvature to the main object.
title: Silver Porringer
